text_block_list.text: ââPhew...!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
………… So this is what a real race is 
like...—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: (————Ah. The wind feels so nice...—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
(......Sis. I feel like I understand just 
a little bit why you were always smiling—)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Man, Dream Journey was pretty good. I 
might start rooting for her from now 
on...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
If she runs for as long as Stego, seeing 
her debut race today might be super rare, 
don't you think...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hello. ...Yes. I had the pleasure of 
watching it in person.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Honestly. If only you would see it for 
yourself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Of course I know that. This is a spiteful 
remark.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Everything seemed to go very 
smoothly. I am looking forward to what 
comes next—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I went to welcome Dream Journey back 
from a safe finish in her debut race—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: I have returned.
choice_data_list: Good work! That was a great run!
Good work! That was a great run!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. I also got a good 
feel for it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dream Journey looks more satisfied than 
ever after finishing her run...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems this turned out to be the best 
debut race possible for her. I'm as happy 
about it as if it were my own—

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
—Dream Journey! Great work out there in 
your debut!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: The other day's—

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my, that run was reminiscent of 
Stay Gold once again today! Please, tell 
us about your aspirations for the future!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dream Journey gently cuts off my words. 
...Perhaps she has something in mind.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"……To reiterate, as someone who admires 
Stay Gold――"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
As her follower, so to speak, I intend to 
run through the upcoming Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: Ooh...!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: And on top of that—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
As Dream Journey, I intend to aim for even 
greater heights.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ââPlease, look forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: Ngh...—

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you very much...! We should keep 
our eyes on Dream Journey's future 
performances...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The reporter answered, but somehow... 
their expression seemed even more strained 
than when they first showed up—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During a meeting to confirm our Junior 
Class strategy with Dream Journey—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Then, let's keep our Junior Class primary 
goal as planned: the Asahi Hai Futurity 
Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Asahi Hai FS is a 1600m turf GⅠ race 
held at Hanshin Racecourse, and one of the 
few GⅠ races held during the Junior tier.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Not only is it a vital race that directly 
connects to next year's Classic races—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This will also lead to Dream Journey 
becoming a standout prospect of her 
generation much earlier than Stay Gold 
did...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The 3-year plan Dream Journey had shown 
me before made mention of the Asahi Hai 
FS, too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I already know that as she aims for the 
Classic Triple Crown, she has a fierce 
determination set on this race—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Even before running in the Classic 
races, simply getting to enter a GⅠ in the 
first place is an exceptionally difficult 
road—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"I would appreciate it if you could 
evaluate my condition even more strictly 
from now on."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, setting the Asahi Hai FS as the 
destination of her Junior-year journey, 
she set into motion...!
